title: From Olivia Rodrigo to Alex Warren & JENNIE, Which New Music Release Is Your Favorite This Week? Vote!
summary: Rod Wave, Billy Strings and Erykah Badu & The Alchemist also have new projects out.
contentText:
Olivia Rodrigo , Alex Warren , JENNIE and more stars are making sure the month of August closes out with a packed weekend of new music releases.

With her inaugural Daisy Chain Fields just around the corner, Rodrigo unleashed “Serena Joy” — poignantly named after the Handmaid’s Tale character — earlier in the week. The fiery standalone track calls out those who turn a blind eye to injustice and fittingly arrives in time for the pop star’s all-women festival in Irvine, Calif., which will raise money for organizations supporting women and girls with a lineup that includes Chappell Roan, Doechii, Mitski, The Breeders, Stevie Nicks, Karen O, Sarah McLachlan and more.

Building on the momentum of his 2025 album You’ll Be Aright, Kid , Warren returns with a new full-length titled WILDCHILD , while JENNIE enters her next solo era with EP Fallen Angel . The BLACKPINK star’s latest set comes as two of her bandmates — JISOO and LISA — are also gearing up for new solo endeavors, as recently announced .

Other new projects include Rod Wave’s Don’t Look Down , Billy Strings’ So Much for Goodbyes , Alabama Shakes’ I Must Be Dreaming , Natanael Cano’s self-titled album, Ladrones’ Arriba La L , Erykah Badu and The Alchemist’s Before The World Blows , Ky-Mani Marley’s Love and Energy and Carly Pearce’s Honest Woman . Plus, new singles from flowerovlove and Willow, Angèle and Chase & Status featuring Debbie — “girls will be girls,” “Une seule vie” and “Gone Too Far,” respectively — are out now for fans to dive into.

The question remains: Which of the new songs, EPs and albums is your favorite music release this week? Tell us your pick by voting in the poll below.
